purpose: Map V2 paper-history data available for MFE/MAE/ROE/hold-time style fields in extended portfolio_state and position_context. Read-only; full_observation_builder.py is not modified.
v2_native_snapshot_only_keys_present: v2:paper:ledger (latest snapshot only; held_by_paper_fill_gate snapshot inside)
rationale: V2 paper Redis publishes snapshots, not time-series histories. There is no Redis stream, list, or `*_history` key carrying per-position trajectory data. MFE (Maximum Favorable Excursion), MAE (Maximum Adverse Excursion), ROE-over-position, and hold-time-statistics all require continuous per-position state captured over the position's lifetime; V2 does not record this today.
alternative_v2_native_sources: v2/runtime/paper_shadow_observation.log (paper shadow observation publisher writes a log line per cycle; not Redis-queryable but contains time-series state).
v2:paper:ledger.accepted/blocked (snapshot lists; could be tracked over time by a new history aggregator, but doing so requires a new V2 service).
operator_decision_options: DEFER_POSITION_HISTORY: keep MFE/MAE/ROE/hold-time slots explicit-missing (current default).
APPROVE_V2_POSITION_HISTORY_AGGREGATOR: build v2/backend/app/cli/v2_paper_position_history_aggregator_loop.py reading paper snapshots into time-series; new Codex review pair required.
